sloka: तदा प्रकृतिम् आपन्नो भवान् स्वर्गम् गमिष्यति ।अनुपस्थीयमानो माम् स क्रुद्धो व्याजहार ह  ॥३-४-१८॥
transliteration: tadā prakṛtim āpanno bhavān svargam gamiṣyati ।anupasthīyamāno mām sa kruddho vyājahāra ha  ॥3-4-18॥

translations.english: When king Kubera saw me absent (from duty) as I was infatuated with Rambha, he got angry and cursed me.
